control_scope: evidence learning disabled or external selector; all share previously learned neuronal literal-edit motor

external_policy: unique maximum cosine of normalized query and span vectors, regardless of sign; STOP only for empty inventory or exact tied maxima; ignores learned weights and STOP

kind: public development full-choice supervised acquisition; no fresh adjudication
